summary.text: Tony Rodriguez is the Republican candidate for California State Senate District 20 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Democrat Caroline Menjivar.
A U.S. Army veteran, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that his priorities are accountability in government, community safety and lowering the cost of living.

paragraphs.text: Tony Rodriguez was born in New York, New York, and served in the U.S. Army from 1980 to 2005.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he was raised in Northeast Los Angeles, graduated from Franklin High School and moved to Tujunga in 1994.

He said he served on the State Disability Board for the Regional Center in Pomona/San Gabriel Valley and is part of the founding team at Lead Staffing, established in 2011, and its Lead Mission Critical division.
Rodriguez advanced from the June 2, 2026 primary against Menjivar.
Ballotpedia lists his affiliations as a neighborhood council, a local chamber of commerce and American Legion Post 377.
